app.title: SKSE Forge
app.subtitle: Universal SKSE Plugin Modernizer (Skyrim SE/AE)
app.description: Automated migration to CommonLibSSE-NG with native support for Address Library binary format 5+ (1.6.1130, 1.6.1170, and 1.7.104+).

modes.forge_desc: Migrates C++ source code to modern CommonLibSSE-NG. Resolves engine offsets at compile-time with absolute native stability.
modes.binary_desc: Modernizes closed-source or abandoned mods without source code. Converts Address Library Format 5 to Format 2, applies hex byte patches, and packages for MO2/Vortex.

binary.view_subtitle: Modernize and achieve compatibility for any legacy SKSE mod (.dll or .zip) without compilers or source code.
binary.dropzone_title: Drag & drop mod .DLL or .ZIP file here
binary.dropzone_desc: Supports direct .dll files or archived .zip mod packages from Nexus Mods, LoversLab, etc.
binary.invalid_file_type: Please provide a valid .dll or .zip file.
binary.high_risk_notice: Note: Plugins hooking Flash/Scaleform UI structures may experience struct layout shifts in 1.6.1170+. If the mod has UI issues, use the dedicated hex recipe.
binary.opt_convert_al_desc: Converts Format 5 to Format 2 for 1.6.1130+ legacy compatibility
binary.opt_apply_hex_desc: Injects byte alignment shifts and legacy version checks bypasses
binary.opt_zip_mo2_desc: Packages SKSE/Plugins structure into an installable ZIP archive
binary.success_subtitle: The mod has been adapted for backward compatibility and packaged for direct installation.
